structured_output.world_model:
W2 (empirical), after E062/E063 crash. Tip E061: 5.0235 s, 0.7534 (seeds 0-2). Same-commit rebuilds move the 3-seed mean about 0.1-0.3 pp (E036: 0.7497-0.7544; E049: 0.7535/0.7552/0.7536) and time about 0.03-0.05 s.

Mechanisms, each tied to its experiments:
1. Epoch dial: about 0.8-1.5 s/pp; I price it at about 1 s/pp. E061 (−12 early 20 px steps) saved about 0.15 s at about 0 pp on 3 seeds (E041 earlier read −0.2).
2. EMA/Lookahead (+0.97 pp, E005) and Muon are load-bearing. E062: SGD in place of Muon costs 2.3-3 pp. More than 10 time-neutral boosters (E025, E029, E030, E032, E044, wd and LS) came out flat or negative, so I expect further tweaks to land within ±0.15 pp of zero. Only wd ×0.5 (E016) was a real gain.
3. Time tracks pixels and steps. Early 20 px is nearly free (E026, E033). Removing steps or samples costs about the dial's rate (E031, E040, E041, E048).
4. Backward truncation is the best lever (E028, E034, E036, E046, E049). Freezing the stem before about 75% loses (E037, E054, E055). Group 2 tolerates a freeze from 85-90%. The whitening detach at 6% saved little (E060).
5. Activation and architecture cuts cost accuracy at the dial's rate or worse (E010, E021, E051, E056). ReLU saved about 0.25 s and cost 0.5 pp.
6. Non-step overhead is about 2.5-5% (E047). A merged optimizer call could save maybe 1%.
7. Noise: the population mean is about 0.752-0.7535, so headroom over the bar is about 0.2 pp. Seed sets used for keeps carry a winner's curse of 0.1-0.2 pp.

Misses: I over-predicted time when variants cut work (E052, E056, E062). I badly underrated Muon in E062. I under-predicted accuracy on E053. Time ranges should lean lower for work cuts.

Unsure:
- Rebuild SD of a 20-seed mean (guess 0.06-0.08 pp).
- Whether tanh-GELU or SiLU gives a real time saving.
- Whether the PCIe judge's build matches the local one.
- Whether early-trim savings continue linearly beyond 225 steps (E063 crashed).
- Whether Muon lr or momentum is off-optimum.

forecasts.reason: Tanh-GELU and SiLU likely save under 1.5% (same bytes), so the gate closes with no run. If a run happens, it is flat.
Time-neutral by design. The LR floor mattered little under averaging (E009), so I expect a gain of about +0.03 pp, within noise.
It costs about 0.09 s and buys perhaps +0.08 pp, near the dial's break-even.
E014 showed a small positive effect (+0.09 pp) at 3 seeds. The lr is probably near a flat optimum, so I expect +0.04 pp.
Launch and host overhead from three Muon calls is plausibly 1-2%, and the math is the same. Accuracy changes only through the rebuild draw.
Higher momentum is likely flat to slightly negative with only 225 steps and Lookahead; the sign is unclear.
A diagnostic with no recipe change. Train top-1 is likely 80-90%, which indicates under-fitting.

cruxes: Does the Muon optimizer section carry more than 1% of non-NS launch/host overhead per step? A per-step CUDA-event measurement would settle I107 and H2.2.5.
Does the early-trim saving stay linear beyond 225 steps (E063 crashed)? If not, the free early steps are used up.
What is the build-to-build SD of a 20-seed mean? It sets whether any sub-0.1 pp comparison, including I104-I108, can be decided.
